text:
Type: trellis patterned low-pile rug
Use: anchoring a seating or dining area; living room, dining room, bedroom
Style: contemporary, classic, modern
Materials: short dense low pile
Colors: dark charcoal grey, white
Shape: rectangular, flat low pile, allover white Moroccan lantern trellis outline on a solid grey ground, clean edges, medium visual weight
Feel: elegant, crisp, balanced
Goes with: white or grey sofas, light wood, chrome or black metal; contemporary, classic or modern rooms

product.name: HOVSLUND
product.description: Suitable for use underneath your dining table, as the flat-woven surface makes it easy to pull out chairs and clean.
